title: Well and Bell
author: Marguerite Eastwick
blurb: Ines Eastwick, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
